title: Story premise ENT054: The Five-Block Balance
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Use four blocks. Leave one out. Make it level. Takeaway/theme: Equal totals can come from different combinations.
description: A maker must place blocks of weights 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 on a toy balance while leaving exactly one block unused. They set 1+5 opposite 2+4, leaving 3 as the prize pedestal; both sides total 6 and the final block displays the answer.
